AccessMulti.description: How a multi-valued upstream duration (`0.010, 0.020 : 0.003`) is combined.

max_size.description: Size that triggers the rotation (`50MB`, `512KB`, `1GB`). Required by `rename-reopen`.

reopen.description:
How to make the server reopen the file after the rename: required (and only valid)
with `rename-reopen`. `command` or `signal`, like `reload`.

AccessSpec.description:
`logs[].access`: where each field of a request lives in a JSON log line.

Every pointer is an RFC 6901 JSON pointer (`/request/host`).

host.description: Host header (a string; may carry a port).

lenient_escapes.description:
The server writes escapes that are not JSON (Apache `\xhh`, `\v`): the parser
rewrites them before decoding.

rotate.description: Rotation of this log. Default: strategy `none`.

upstream_duration.description: Time spent in the upstream; omitted when the server does not log it.

start.description:
The timestamp is the instant the request arrived (Apache `%{msec}t`), not when it
finished: the end is `ts + duration`. Default `false`.

AccessUnit.description: Unit of a numeric log field.

strip_query.description:
The value carries a query string (Caddy `request.uri`) that must be dropped.
Default `false`.

ApiVersion.description: `apiVersion` of a manifest. Anything other than `forgebox.dev/v1` is rejected.

Apply.description: When a changed setting takes effect (`apply`).

oneOf.description: Graceful reload (recycle of the PHP pool, `nginx -s reload`...).
Restart of the service (always correct; default).
Nothing to do (read on next start or per request).
A single file copied as is (`.exe`, `.dll`, `.phar`).

AssetChecksum.description: Checksum published as a release asset (`checksums.txt`, `{asset}.sha256`).

asset.description: Asset name; `{asset}` is replaced by the downloaded asset name.

prerelease.description: Whether pre-releases (`8.6.0-RC1`) belong to the channel. Default `false`.

url.description: URL template of the checksum file (`{url}`, `{file}` and the provider placeholders).

ClientCommand.description: A client program: `exe` relative to the version folder (rule 6) and its argv.

env.description: Variables injected in the processes of the tool.

ConfigFormat.description: Format of a config file; decides how quick settings are written.

oneOf.description: Apache/Nginx directives; edited only inside the managed block.
Command line arguments of the service.
Plain text: editable, no quick settings.

ConsoleSignal.description: Console control event sent to the process group.

from.description: Relative to the version folder, or starting with `{{ paths.<dir> }}`.

if_missing.description: Keep an existing destination (user edits). Default `false`.

CopyDirAction.description: `migrate[].copy_dir`: paths relative to the old and new version folders.

only_missing.description: Only files missing in the new version. Default `false`.

depends_on.description: Tools whose service must be `Running` first.

health.description: Default: the process being alive is enough.

multi_instance.description: Several named instances with their own data dirs and ports. Default `false`.

init.description: Run once when `dir` does not exist yet.

create.description: Uses `{{ database }}` and may use `{{ charset }}`.

list.description: One database name per row (first column).

DatabaseSpec.description:
`spec.database` (docs/04 §1.8): everything the daemon needs to list, create and drop
databases, dump/restore them and build connection strings, without per-tool code.

admin_user.description: Administrative account the client connects with.

client.description:
Runs one SQL statement: `args` hold `{{ sql }}` and the client prints
tab-separated rows without a header.

default_charset.description: Value of `{{ charset }}` when the caller gives none (`[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,32}`).

dump.description: Writes the dump to stdout (`{{ database }}`).

restore.description: Reads the dump from stdin (`{{ database }}`).

match_files.description: Files that must exist in the folder.

version_regex.description: Regex with group 1 = version, applied to the output. Default: trimmed output.

Duration.description: Duration with an explicit unit, e.g. "15s", "2m", "1h", "1h 30m".

oneOf.description: Files shipped in the tool archive (`ext/*.dll`).

dir.description:
Folder of the extension files, relative to the version folder, `/`-separated.
Default `ext`. An extension of `defaults_on` without its file there is built into
that build (or absent) and is not written to the overlay.

pattern.description: File name of an extension with `{name}` (`php_{name}.dll`).

zend_extensions.description:
`zend_extension=` lines of the overlay (`opcache`), optionally gated by a version
constraint (same syntax as `versioning.channels.*.constraint`).

constraint.description: Version constraint in the tool scheme (`"<8.5"`); absent = always.

Install.description: `spec.install` of a Tool. Every field has a default.

archive.description: Default: inferred from the file name (`ArchiveFormat::infer`).

path.description: Sub-folders exposed on PATH through `current` (`"."`). Default: none.

post_install.description: Declarative, idempotent actions run in order after extraction.

project_key.description:
Dotted key of a project `forgebox.yaml` (`kind: Project`) holding the version of
this tool (`spec.site.php`). `spec.runtimes[]` entries with `tool: <id>` always
count.

shims.description:
`bin/shims/<name>.cmd`: runs `<name>` (`.exe`, `.com`, `.cmd` or `.bat`, searched in
the version folder and its `path` subfolders) of the version selected by the
project (`version_files`, `project_key`) or of `current` (docs/06 §2.3).

version_files.description:
Files that select the version of this tool for a project folder, looked up in the
current directory and its ancestors by the shims (`.php-version`, `.nvmrc`). The
first word of the first line is a series or an exact version (`8.3`, `v22.12.0`).

access.description:
Field mapping and rotation of a structured access log (`format: forgebox-json`);
consumed by forge-metrics and the log rotation (docs/04 section 1.2, docs/14 section 2).

format.description: Parser id for the log viewer (`mysql`, `nginx-error`, `json`). Default: plain text.

api.description: API family the daemon adapter speaks.

http_port.description: Name of the HTTP/API port in `service.daemon.ports[]`.

smtp_port.description: Name of the SMTP port in `service.daemon.ports[]`.

PoolProtocol.description: Protocol spoken by the pool workers.

port_range.description: Named range of `forgebox.toml`; must exist (rule 3). Default `php-pools`.

default.description: Preferred port; default: first free port of `range`.

env.description: Environment variable that receives the port.

PostInstallAction.description: `install.post_install[]`: one action, written as a single-key map (`- copy: {...}`).

oneOf.description: Folder to create (inside the root: starts with `{{ paths.<dir> }}`).

ProgramService.description: `service.oneshot` / `service.gui`: a program launched by the engine.

include_archives.description: Also list old versions from `releases/archives/`. Default `true`.

qa.description: QA/RC builds (`qa/`), only for channels with `prerelease`. Default `false`.

asset.description:
Regex for the file name; default: the `httpd-<version>-<date>-win64-VS<nn>.zip` archive.
Modules on the same page (mod_fcgid) set their own.

oneOf.description:
`type: nginx-org`: `nginx.org/en/download.html` (mainline and stable). Upstream has no
hash (PGP only), so `releases[].sha256` is curated (rule 2).

checksum.description: Checksum asset; without it, `releases[].sha256` is required (rule 2).

version_regex.description: Regex with one group extracting the version from the tag. Default: tag without a leading `v`.

oneOf.description: `type: python-embed`: python.org packages; hashes are curated (rule 2).

vars.description: Extra placeholders mapped from a variant value: `{ ts_flag: { nts: "nts", ts: "" } }`.

version_source.description: Where to list versions when `releases:` is empty.

oneOf.description: `type: local`: archive given by the user (`forge tool add-local <zip>`).

also_set.description: Other keys written with the same value (`{ post_max_size: "{{ value }}" }`).

on.description: Value written by a `toggle` when on/off. Default: the native boolean of the format.

reserve.description: `port`: reserve the port in the allocator (Xdebug 9003). Default `false`.

RotateStrategy.description: How the daemon keeps an access log from growing forever.

oneOf.description: The daemon renames the file (`access.json.1`...) and asks the server to reopen it.
The server rotates by itself (Caddy `roll_*`, configured in the template).
Not rotated (provisional for Apache until M2-E5-T12).

RunAction.description:
A command run by the engine (`post_install[].run`, `post_create[].run`).

In `post_install`, the executable (first token of `command`) is resolved inside
`{{ paths.version }}` and never through `PATH` (docs/04 §6 rule 6, docs/11 §2).

timeout.description: Default: no limit other than the job's.

Service.description: `spec.service`: `kind` plus the block of that kind (`daemon:`, `pool:`, `oneshot:`, `gui:`).

oneOf.description: Long-running process managed by the supervisor.
Graphical app launched on demand, outside the Job.

ShellAction.description: `ui.actions[].shell`: terminal with this version first on PATH.

Shim.description: An item of `install.shims`: `php` or `{ name, file, interpreter }`.

ShimSpec.description: Object form of [`Shim`] (`{ name: composer, file: composer.phar, interpreter: php }`).

file.description:
File run by the shim, relative to the version folder with `/` (`composer.phar`).
Default: `<name>` with `.exe`, `.com`, `.cmd` or `.bat`.

interpreter.description:
Another shim that runs `file` (`php` for a `.phar`): the shim calls
`bin/shims/<interpreter>.cmd <file> <args>`, so the interpreter's own project
version applies too.

mirrors.description: URL templates with `{file}` tried in order after the original URL.

providers.description: Tried in order; the first that resolves the version wins.

releases.description: Static list of releases (curated by the registry bot when upstream has no API/hash).

url.description: Omitted when the provider builds the URL (`http` with `url`).

variants.description: Variant values of this build (`{ ts: nts, compiler: vs17, arch: x64 }`).

command.description: First attempt (`mysqladmin shutdown`, `nginx -s quit`). Default: none.

then.description: Next step if the command does not stop it. Default `ctrl-break`.

StopSignal.description: Stop step after `stop.command`; the cascade always ends with `kill` (Job Object).

StripRoot.description: true, false or auto (remove a single top-level folder if present).

ToolId.description: Tool slug: [a-z0-9-], starts and ends with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters.

deprecated.description: Hidden from the catalog (installed versions are kept).

description.description: Long Markdown text shown in the catalog.

icon.description: SVG file in `registry/icons/` or an `https://` URL (rule 7).

database.description: Database capability (docs/04 §1.8): the daemon drives the declared client.

depends_on.description: Other tools that must be installed.

runtime_deps.description: System prerequisites known by the engine (`vcredist-vs17`).

suggests.description: Offered by the UI after installing.

keep.description: Paths preserved when the version is removed.

migrate.description: What to carry from the old version to the new one in the same series.

retention.description: Previous versions kept per series for rollback.

default.description: Preferred value; ranks before the others.

values.description: Values in order of preference (`[nts, ts]`, `[vs17, vs16, vc15]`).

VariantDerive.description: Where the value of a variant comes from when the user does not choose it.

oneOf.description: The provider reports it with each release.

Verify.description: `install.verify`: command run inside the version folder after install.

regex.description: Regex whose group 1 must equal the installed version. Default: exit code 0 is enough.

VersionScheme.description: How versions of a tool are written and compared (`spec.versioning.scheme`).

oneOf.description: Semantic versioning (`8.3.37`, `1.27.0-rc1`); `X` and `X.Y` are read as `X.0.0`/`X.Y.0`.
Calendar versions (`2024.10.1`): dot-separated, first segment numeric.
Free text (`12.8.0.6908`, `2.47.1.windows.1`), compared segment by segment.

VersionSource.description: `version_source` of an `http` provider: one of `regex` or `json_path`.

json_path.description: JSONPath to the list of versions.

regex.description: Regex with one capture group per version, applied to the body.

series_key.description: Groups versions into a series (`{major}`, `{minor}`, `{patch}`). Default `{major}.{minor}`.

variants.description: Orthogonal build dimensions, in the order used by the folder name (docs/08 §5).

ZendExtension.description: An item of `config.extensions.zend_extensions`: `opcache` or `{ name, constraint }`.

anyOf.description: Emitted only when `constraint` matches the installed version.
